name: chamfer_dimension_matches_its_feature
why: REPORT 8CD843, ROUND 21 (28/10/2026). On the drawing of 26P000011 the front view printed «0,4 x 15,23°» for its chamfer, 0.4 x 45°: the dimension measured the chamfer seen askew (0.415 mm x cos 15.23° = 0.4), and the step said it had dimensioned the chamfer. The chamfer dimension is now compared with the definition of its feature; one that does not agree is taken away and another edge of the same chamfer is tried. This case holds the other side: a chamfer that is NOT at 45° (3 x 6), seen in its true size, keeps its dimension and is said to agree.
defect_caught: A right chamfer dimension taken away because it is not at 45° or its legs come in the other order (the comparison of the legs taken as one way only), and a chamfer dimension that says nothing about its feature.
_why_these_numbers: The plate of «drawing_dimensions_holes_and_chamfer» without the holes, 120 x 80 x 10, with the top back edge along X chamfered 3 x 6 (the bevel of «chamfer_3x6_bevel»): 96000 - 3 x 6 / 2 x 120 = 94920 mm3. In V3 that edge runs along the line of sight, so the chamfer is seen in its true size, as the 5 x 45 of that case.

expect.tolerance_why: 96000 - 1080 exactly; the hundredth is the reading of the volume
expect.why: the chamfer 3 x 6 is there: a 3 x 3 would remove 540, a 6 x 6 2160
